Hi Samantha / team — attaching the perf report from the runs we executed this week. Key summary (see PerfReport_20261201.pdf for full graphs and raw csv):
- Hosted (shared pool):
  - 95th latency @ 1k tokens: 210ms median, 95th = 340ms (variance under noisy load)
  - TTFT (first token): median 55ms, 99th = 220ms during noisy neighbor spikes
  - Sustained throughput: 400 req/min at concurrency 64 with batching; degradation > 128 concurrency
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool):
  - 95th latency @ 1k tokens: 185ms median, 95th = 240ms (very stable)
  - TTFT: median 28ms, 99th = 90ms
  - Sustained throughput: linear scaling to 512 concurrent streams across the pool (subject to cluster size)
- Private (customer VPC, on-prem like):
  - 95th latency caveat: depends on customer infra — tested on a 4xA100 setup we provisioned: 95th = 200ms, TTFT = 32ms
  - Predictability: similar to Dedicated when isolated hardware with tuned networking

Autoscaling behavior notes:
- Hosted: conservative autoscaler to avoid noisy neighbor impact; scales by queue depth with cooldowns (30–60s) — good for steady traffic but shows higher tail at sudden spikes.
- Dedicated: customer-controlled autoscaling (policy-driven); we recommend target-based scaling with predictive buffer for settlement windows.
- Private: depends on customer k8s/config; we provide autoscaling recommendations and a tested configuration (included in PerfReport).

Attachments: PerfReport_20261201.pdf, PerfRaw_20261201.csv

Next steps I suggest:
- SMB test: run 2-hour sustained load with 128 concurrency on Hosted vs Dedicated with identical request traces (we ran 30-minute samples; recommend 2-hour for tail stability).
- Deliver artifacts and dashboards by 2026-12-07 so StellarPay can run internal validation.

-Karthik
